source.display_title: 07/18/2026 - Impromptu Zoom Meeting (Tyron Giuliani) — Follow Up

call.sequence_note: Explicitly call two of a sequence — 'we ended off yesterday, we were going through the program'. The prior call is a separate transcript.

prospect.name: Tyron Giuliani
prospect.training_background: Ex-army. Currently 2x/week with a personal trainer, plus chiro and physio. Lower-body and machine work.
prospect.medical: Rotator cuff injury from army service ~30 years ago: partial anterior rotator cuff tear, labrum damage, AC joint arthritis. Herniated L5/S1 disc. Traumatic microfracture, left tibia. Currently receiving weekly hyaluronic acid injections; MRI two weeks prior shows stable. Exploring surgery.

signals: High intent and strong engagement — 'I'm excited to do this, I like Trevor'
Blocker is entirely clinical, not financial and not motivational
Has an active care team (orthopedic surgeon, physio, chiro, PT) whose advice overrides the rep's
Physio explicitly ruled out the core kettlebell movement library
Loss risk is the offer's fit, not the offer's price

goals.text: Build core strength to avoid falls with age
Be able to train at home on a mat in his own room

pains.text: Rotator cuff tear, labrum damage and AC joint arthritis blocking overhead loading
Herniated L5/S1 disc from army service
Physio ruled out swings, snatches, cleans, Turkish get-ups, overhead presses, push press, windmills and high pulls
Unexplained shoulder pain flare the day after the previous sales call
History of being up and down with fitness; lacks consistency
Disappointment and deflation after the physio consult killed his excitement

objections.raw_quote: he would avoid the stuff that I was hoping I could do, which is like the kettlebell swings, the snatches, the cleans, the Turkish get-ups, overhead presses... that's the stuff I kind of wanted to be doing more of
objections.rep_response: Even if we can only do 50% of what we normally would, Trevor can design a program in the right direction and you'd see an extensive transformation. Goal is longevity and sustainability.

objections.raw_quote: is there enough value for me to just work on lower body stuff and protect the shoulder?
objections.rep_response: Asked him to send MRI reports and the PT's do/don't list so Trevor could assess feasibility.

objections.raw_quote: You've got it stabilized at the moment, and they're not sure if me swinging around is the best idea
objections.rep_response: What would be the route to actually getting you back to swinging stuff around and doing the upper body stuff?

evidence: Agreed next step: prospect sends MRI reports and PT exercise list to the rep via WhatsApp
Rep to submit to Trevor for a feasibility assessment
No close attempted on this call; price never revisited
Prospect still warm — 'I'm still watching Trevor' — but says 'I was a little bit bummed'
No follow-up call actually booked, only an open-ended handoff
outcome.next_step: Prospect sends MRI + PT list; Trevor assesses program feasibility. No date set.

notable.note: The only one of the five where the blocker is clinical rather than commercial. Also the only one where no specific follow-up date was set — the next step depends on the prospect sending documents unprompted, which is a weak commitment.

quality.notes: Swaps concentrated in short exchanges. The long clinical monologue is clearly the prospect and is reliably attributed. A 3-minute silent gap at 00:09-00:13 suggests audio loss.
